# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Rank:** Former Guildmaster / Senior Official
- **Role:** Guildmaster and merchant administrator
- **Titles:** Guildmaster Tulk

## Appearance

Anthony Tulk is described as a stout, well-dressed man who carries himself with the quiet authority of a seasoned bureaucrat. He wears fine woolen robes suited to his high standing in mercantile circles. His calculated demeanor and sharp, observant eyes reflect his decades of navigating political and economic intrigue.

## Personality

Tulk is pragmatic, cautious, and deeply invested in maintaining stability within trade networks. He prioritizes institutional continuity and economic prosperity over ideological squabbles. Though capable of ruthlessness when his interests are threatened, he generally prefers negotiation and quiet leverage.

## Traits

- Pragmatic
- Calculated
- Fear of economic ruin and instability

## Abilities

- Mercantile administration and trade negotiations
- Political lobbying and covert diplomacy

## Goals

- Protect local commercial interests from imperial overreach
- Maintain the influence and autonomy of the guild

## History

Anthony Tulk emerged as a prominent power broker during the trade disputes that destabilized the local economy. Throughout the earlier volumes, he worked behind the scenes to balance the interests of local merchants against escalating imperial demands. His efforts to secure guild neutrality were compromised as regional conflicts intensified, forcing him into uneasy pacts with rival factions. By Volume 4, his maneuvers caught up with him when covert deals were exposed during the siege crisis, leading to his downfall and death amidst the political purge.

## Background by volume

- Rose through the ranks of the merchant guild through shrewd investments and strategic alliances
- Long served as a primary liaison between local merchants and regional nobility

## Affiliations

- Merchant Guild — Guildmaster
